g.text: KESTREL K1 — Knee hub with integral crank, Mk II (H5)
Tolerances: journals Ø35 k5 coaxial 0.01; 12x M6 6H on PCD 90; 2x Ø6 H7; crank pin Ø12 H7 at r 73.7 · Finish: hard anodise, journals masked
Dimension from the STEP model; general tolerances per docs/09 §2. Break sharp edges 0.2–0.5 mm. Projection: isometric, hidden lines grey.
